prerequisite: Learner can read contour circles as level sets of f(x,y) = x squared plus y squared.

scenes.concept_target: Gradient steps descend level sets toward the minimum; one justified zoom confirms the structure at the bottom.

narration_cues.change: Concentric contour circles for one f(x,y) appear.
narration_cues.text: Predict before we move: this bowl f of x y equals x squared plus y squared has circular level sets. Watch them appear.

narration_cues.change: Gradient path dots descend inward across the contours.
narration_cues.text: Now test your prediction: gradient dots step downhill, crossing each circle toward lower values.

narration_cues.change: Camera zooms once to the center and the minimum is marked and held readable.
narration_cues.text: One justified zoom moves inward to reveal the minimum: the dots settle at the center where the bowl is lowest.

scenes.title: Contour plus gradient path camera reveal

success_check: Learner predicts the next dot moves inward and explains why the single zoom was needed to confirm the minimum.
title: Gradient path on contours finds the minimum
